messages.mdx_review.choose_release: Choose a Release, or create one
messages.mdx_review.choose_version: Choose an explicitly saved version. A later working draft does not replace a fixed Release member. Another author must review before publication.
messages.mdx_review.publication_note: Publication writes the selected version’s mirror and records it locally. It does not check a last-minute external file hash.
messages.mdx_review.release_not_created: The Release could not be created.
messages.mdx_review.title: Review an MDX publication
